name: harness-rsi
description: A priority board for harness self-improvement proposals: each card shows the pain and how many people hit it, the page before and the mock after, the change cost and the exams that will judge it, and three buttons to decide. A signals tab lists every signal by heat. Opt-in: nothing runs until you enable it, and it never acts on its own.
author: iamwhatever
highlights: One card per proposal: pain, heat (people / days), before vs after, cost, exams
Three buttons per card set the decision: 做 / 不做 / 以后再说
Signals tab ordered by heat, merged duplicates marked

Nothing on its own by default: it shows the shared data, records your choice, refreshes signals when you press Refresh, and runs a design-crew round when you press Run round and confirm. An optional schedule (off until you turn it on in Settings) runs one round a week and a daily regression check, each ending in one notification; it never posts to Slack, opens a PR or merges

Optional auto-dispatch (off until you turn it on in Settings): 做 on a proposal card opens one worker chat, seeded with the card, that builds it as one small PR to an allowlisted repo, CI green, never merged; at most 2 a day by default
Reads Slack itself through your own Slack MCP server (read tools only, allowlisted channel ids); off until you set the command on the Settings tab
